possessed of goodness, virtuous (gen. pl., 'of the virtuous')
I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)

sentences.l: The-gambling, of-cheats, I-am; splendor, of-the-splendid, I; victory-I-am, resolve-I-am, goodness, of-the-virtuous, I.
sentences.i: I am the gambling of cheats; I am the splendor of the splendid; I am victory, I am resolve; I am the goodness of the virtuous.
sentences.n: chalayatām, 'of those who deceive, cheats', names gambling as their characteristic activity, claimed here as Kṛṣṇa's own — a startling inclusion in the catalog, matched by other morally ambiguous items already claimed (Time as death-dealer at v.30, the rod of punishment to come at v.38); sattvam here is 'goodness' in its ordinary sense (courage, virtue, integrity), not the technical guṇa of that name, as the pairing with sattvavatām, 'the virtuous', makes clear. Sandhi: तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् shows tejaḥ's visarga realized as -as before the voiceless t- of tejasvinām, the same pattern seen at 10.6's manavas tathā; जयोऽस्मि and व्यवसायोऽस्मि both show -aḥ+a-→-o- (avagraha), as regularly.

sentences.t:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
sentences.tr:
vṛṣṇīnām vāsudevaḥ asmi pāṇḍavānām dhanaṃjayaḥ |
munīnām api aham vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśanā kaviḥ ||

morph.gloss: the Vṛṣṇis, Kṛṣṇa's own clan (gen. pl., 'of the Vṛṣṇis')
'son of Vasudeva', Kṛṣṇa's own patronymic and epithet, here named foremost of his own clan (nom. sg., predicate; vāsudevaḥ + asmi: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha)
to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
a son of Pāṇḍu, i.e. Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma, Arjuna, Nakula or Sahadeva (gen. pl., 'of the Pāṇḍavas')
'winner of wealth', an epithet of Arjuna (nom. sg., predicate)
sage (gen. pl., 'of sages')
even, also (munīnām + api: joined, no change; api + aham: -i + a- → -y a-)
I (nom. sg., subject)
the sage Vyāsa, traditional compiler of the Vedas and author of the Mahābhārata (nom. sg., in apposition to aham)
poet, seer (gen. pl., 'of poets, seers')
Uśanas, i.e. Śukra, preceptor of the demons, renowned as a poet-sage (nom. sg., an archaic -an-stem form of the name; joined before u-, no change)
poet, seer (nom. sg., in apposition to Uśanā, 'the poet Uśanas')

sentences.l: Of-the-Vṛṣṇis Vāsudeva-I-am; of-the-Pāṇḍavas Dhanañjaya; of-sages even-I [am] Vyāsa; of-poets Uśanas the-poet.
sentences.i: Of the Vṛṣṇis I am Vāsudeva; of the Pāṇḍavas, Dhanañjaya (Arjuna); of sages, even I am Vyāsa; of poets, the poet Uśanas.
sentences.n: Vāsudeva, Kṛṣṇa's own patronymic, names him foremost of his clan, the Vṛṣṇis — Kṛṣṇa identifying with himself; Dhanañjaya, 'winner of wealth', is Arjuna's own epithet, addressed here as if from outside, naming him best of the Pāṇḍavas; Vyāsa is the sage traditionally credited with compiling the Vedas and composing the Mahābhārata itself, the very poem in which this verse occurs; Uśanas, also called Śukra, is preceptor of the demons and a renowned poet-sage — his name here keeps an archaic nominative in -ā rather than the expected -āḥ. Sandhi: वासुदेवोऽस्मि shows -aḥ+a-→-o- (avagraha); मुनीनामप्यहं packs munīnām+api (joined) +aham (-i+a-→-y a-, the glide formation seen since 10.11).

sentences.t:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
sentences.tr:
daṇḍaḥ damayatām asmi nītiḥ asmi jigīṣatām |
maunam ca eva asmi guhyānām jñānam jñānavatām aham ||

morph.gloss: rod, staff; punishment, chastisement (nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ before d- → -o)
to subdue, tame, control (damayatām: causative present participle gen. pl., 'of those who subdue, chastise')
to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
policy, statesmanship, prudent conduct (nom. sg. fem., predicate; nītiḥ + asmi: -iḥ + a- → -ir a-)
to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
to conquer, win (jigīṣat: desiderative present participle, 'wishing to conquer'; jigīṣatām: gen. pl., 'of those who seek victory')
silence (nom. sg. neut., predicate)
and (ca + eva: a + e → ai)
indeed (caiva + asmi: a + a → ā)
to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
secret, hidden thing (gen. pl., 'of secret things')
knowledge (nom. sg. neut., predicate)
possessed of knowledge, knowing (gen. pl., 'of those who have knowledge')
I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)

sentences.l: The-rod, of-those-who-subdue, I-am; the-policy I-am, of-those-who-seek-victory; the-silence and-indeed-I-am, of-secret-things; the-knowledge, of-those-who-have-knowledge, I.
sentences.i: Of those who subdue, I am the rod of punishment; of those who seek victory, I am statesmanship; of secret things, I am silence; and of those who have knowledge, I am knowledge.
sentences.n: daṇḍa, 'the rod', names the coercive power of punishment wielded by those who chastise, damayatām; nīti, 'statecraft, prudent policy', is claimed among jigīṣatām, 'those who desire victory'; mauna, 'silence', is named the foremost of guhyāni, 'secret, hidden things' — silence as the deepest form of keeping a secret; this verse closes the catalog's ethical and political items before the summarizing verses that follow. Sandhi: दण्डो shows -aḥ before d- → -o; नीतिरस्मि shows -iḥ+a-→-ir a-; चैवास्मि packs ca+eva (a+e→ai) +asmi (a+a→ā), as at v.32.

sentences.t:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
sentences.tr:
yat ca api sarva-bhūtānām bījam tat aham arjuna |
na tat asti vinā yat syāt mayā bhūtam cara-acaram ||

morph.gloss: which, what (yat: nom. sg. neut. relative pronoun, referring to bījam, subject of the relative clause; yat + ca: -t + c- → -cc-)
and
even, also (ca + api: a + a → ā)
all (first compound member)
being, creature (sarva-bhūta: gen. pl., 'of all beings')
seed (nom. sg. neut., predicate)
that (tat: nom. sg. neut., correlative resuming yat, predicate of the main clause; tat + aham: -t + a- → -d a-)
I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
Arjuna (vocative)
not
that, it (tat: nom. sg. neut., subject; tat + asti: -t + a- → -d a-)
to be (asti: present 3rd sg. 'there is')
without (adverb/preposition governing mayā, 'without me')
which, that which (yat: nom. sg. neut. relative, subject of syāt, referring forward to bhūtam)
to be (syāt: optative 3rd sg. 'might exist, could be'; yat + syāt: joined, no change; syāt + mayā: -t + m- → -n m-)
I (mayā: instr. sg., 'by me', with vinā, 'without me')
being, creature (nom. sg. neut., subject of syāt)
moving (first compound member)
unmoving, stationary (cara-acara: 'moving or unmoving', nom. sg. neut., agreeing with bhūtam; a + a → ā)

sentences.l: And-which even, of-all-beings, the-seed, that-I-am, Arjuna; not that exists, without-which, might-be by-me, being moving-or-unmoving.
sentences.i: Whatever is the seed of all beings, that am I, Arjuna; there is no being, moving or unmoving, that could exist without me.
sentences.n: The catalog's individual items give way here to a general claim, closing the list proper before the summary of vv.40-42: whatever bījam, 'seed', underlies any being at all, Kṛṣṇa is that seed; the relative-correlative yat...tat construction ('whatever...that') states the identity, and the second relative clause (yat syāt) extends it to every being whatsoever, cara-acaram, 'moving or unmoving' — the standard Sanskrit merism for the whole of creation, animate and inanimate alike. Sandhi: यच्चापि packs yat+ca (-t+c-→-cc-) +api (a+a→ā); तदहमर्जुन and तदस्ति both show tat+a-→-d a- (dental voicing before a vowel); यत्स्यान्मया packs yat+syāt (joined) +mayā (-t+m-→-n m-, the same assimilation of word-final -t before m- seen at 10.14's yan mām); चराचरम् packs cara+acaram (a+a→ā).

sentences.t:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
sentences.tr:
na antaḥ asti mama divyānām vibhūtīnām parantapa |
eṣaḥ tu uddeśataḥ proktaḥ vibhūteḥ vistaraḥ mayā ||

morph.gloss: not (na + antaḥ: a + a → ā)
end (antaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; antaḥ + asti: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha)
to be (asti: present 3rd sg. 'there is')
I (mama: gen. sg. 'my')
divine (gen. pl., agreeing with vibhūtīnām)
manifestation, magnificent power (gen. pl., 'of manifestations', with na antaḥ asti, 'there is no end of')
'scorcher of foes', an epithet of Arjuna (vocative sg.)
this (eṣaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject, referring to the catalog just given; visarga lost before the following consonant, as with sa/eṣa throughout, cf. 10.3)
but, however (tu + uddeśataḥ: u + u → ū)
indication, summary statement (uddeśataḥ: ablative used adverbially, 'by way of indication, roughly, as a sample')
to declare, proclaim (prokta: past participle 'declared, stated', nom. sg. masc., predicate, agreeing with vistaraḥ; -aḥ before v- → -o)
manifestation (vibhūteḥ: gen. sg., 'of [my] manifestation')
extent, expanse, full detail (vistaraḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; vibhūteḥ + vistaraḥ: -eḥ + v- → -er v-; its own visarga becomes -o before the voiced m- of mayā)
I (mayā: instr. sg., 'by me', agent of the passive proktaḥ)

sentences.l: Not-the-end-there-is of-my divine of-manifestations, O-scorcher-of-foes; this but by-way-of-indication declared, of-manifestation the-extent, by-me.
sentences.i: There is no end to my divine manifestations, Parantapa; this is but a sample I have stated of the extent of my manifestation.
sentences.n: This verse begins the closing movement (through v.42), declaring the preceding catalog merely uddeśataḥ, 'by way of indication, as a sample' — an illustrative fraction, not an exhaustive list, of Kṛṣṇa's vistara, 'extent', a term picking up prabhavaḥ vistaraḥ ca from v.18 and vistaro mama of v.19. Parantapa, 'scorcher of foes', addresses Arjuna. Sandhi: नान्तोऽस्ति packs na+antaḥ (a+a→ā) +asti (-aḥ+a-→-o-, avagraha); तूद्देशतः packs tu+uddeśataḥ (u+u→ū); प्रोक्तो shows -aḥ before v-→-o; विभूतेर्विस्तरो packs vibhūteḥ+vistaraḥ (-eḥ+v-→-er v-), whose own visarga becomes -o before the voiced m- of mayā.

sentences.t:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम् ॥
sentences.tr:
yat yat vibhūtimat sattvam śrīmat ūrjitam eva vā |
tat tat eva ava-gaccha tvam mama tejaḥ-aṃśa-sambhavam ||

morph.gloss: whatever, which (yat yat: reduplicated relative, distributive 'whatever...whatever', nom. sg. neut., referring to sattvam; joined, no change)
possessed of vibhūti, glorious, powerful (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with sattvam; joined, no change)
being, existing thing, creature (nom. sg. neut., subject; here 'a being', not the sattva of v.36)
possessed of śrī, splendid, fortunate (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with sattvam; śrīmat + ūrjitam: -t + ū- → -d ū-)
vigorous, powerful, mighty (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with sattvam; joined before e-, no change)
indeed, precisely
or
that (tat tat: reduplicated correlative, distributive 'that...that', acc. sg. neut., resuming yat yat, object of avagaccha; joined, no change; tat + eva: -t + e- → -d e-)
indeed
to understand, perceive, know (avagaccha: imperative 2nd sg. 'understand!'; tadeva + avagaccha: a + a → ā)
you (nom. sg., subject of avagaccha)
I (mama: gen. sg. 'my', governing tejaḥ)
splendor, brilliance (first compound member, governed externally by mama, 'my'; tejaḥ + aṃśa: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha, the aṃśa's own inherent nasal retained)
portion, fraction, share (second compound member)
arising from, sprung from (tejas-aṃśa-sambhava: 'sprung from a fraction of [my] splendor', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with tat tat, predicate complement of avagaccha)

sentences.l: Whatever glorious being, splendid or mighty; that-that indeed-understand you, my of-splendor a-fraction-sprung-from.
sentences.i: Whatever being has glory, splendor, or vigor, know each one to have sprung from a mere fraction of my splendor.
sentences.n: The reduplicated yat yat...tat tat, 'whatever...that', generalizes the whole preceding catalog: any vibhūtimat, 'glorious', śrīmat, 'splendid, fortunate', or ūrjitam, 'mighty' being anywhere, not only the named examples, springs from a mere aṃśa, 'fraction, portion', of Kṛṣṇa's own tejas, 'splendor' — the same tejas already claimed at v.36. Sandhi: श्रीमदूर्जितमेव packs śrīmat+ūrjitam (-t+ū-→-d ū-, a new instance of the dental-voicing-before-vowel pattern seen at tat+aham, tat+asti in v.39); तत्तदेवावगच्छ packs tat+tat (joined) +eva (-t+e-→-d e-) +avagaccha (a+a→ā); तेजोंऽशसंभवम् packs tejaḥ+aṃśa (-aḥ+a-→-o-, avagraha, with aṃśa's inherent nasal surviving).

sentences.t:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
sentences.tr:
athavā bahunā etena kim jñātena tava arjuna |
viṣṭabhya aham idam kṛtsnam eka-aṃśena sthitaḥ jagat ||

morph.gloss: or rather, or else
much, many (bahunā: instr. sg. neut., 'at length, extensively', qualifying jñātena; bahunā + etena: ā + e → ai)
this (etena: instr. sg. neut., 'by this', qualifying jñātena)
what (interrogative, 'what use')
to know (jñāta: past participle 'known'; jñātena: instr. sg. neut., 'by this known thing, by this knowledge')
you (tava: gen. sg. 'your')
Arjuna (vocative; tava + arjuna: a + a → ā)
to prop up, support, sustain (viṣṭabhya: gerund 'having propped up, sustaining'; viṣṭabhya + aham: a + a → ā)
I (nom. sg., subject of sthitaḥ)
this (idam: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat; joined before i-, no change)
whole, entire (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat; joined before e-, no change)
one, single (first compound member; eka + aṃśena: a + a → ā)
portion, fraction (eka-aṃśa: 'a single portion', instr. sg., 'with a single fraction [of myself]')
to stand (sthita: past participle 'standing, abiding', nom. sg. masc., predicate, agreeing with aham; -aḥ before j- → -o)
the world, the universe (acc. sg. neut., object of viṣṭabhya)

sentences.l: Or-rather, with-this-much known, what, for-you, Arjuna; having-propped-up-I this whole with-a-single-fraction, standing, the-world.
sentences.i: Or rather, what use to you is all this detailed knowledge, Arjuna? I stand sustaining this entire universe with a single fraction of myself.
sentences.n: The chapter's closing verse turns from the catalog itself to dismiss it: bahunā...jñātena, 'by this extensive knowledge', is waved off as beside the point, since the point was never the list's completeness but the single fact stated in the second line — viṣṭabhya, 'having propped up, sustained', governs idam kṛtsnam jagat, 'this entire universe', held up by Kṛṣṇa with a mere eka-aṃśena, 'a single portion', of himself, echoing and capping the aṃśa of v.41. Sandhi: बहुनैतेन packs bahunā+etena (ā+e→ai); तवार्जुन packs tava+arjuna (a+a→ā); विष्टभ्याहमिदं packs viṣṭabhya+aham (a+a→ā) +idam (joined, no change); कृत्स्नमेकांशेन packs kṛtsnam+ekāṃśena (joined, no change) with eka+aṃśena internally (a+a→ā); स्थितो shows -aḥ before j-→-o.

glossary.श्रीभगवानुवाच: śrī-bhagavān uvāca — śrī — holy, glorious (honorific prefix); bhagavat — the Blessed One, the Lord — Kṛṣṇa's title as speaker (nom. sg. bhagavān; -n + u- written joined); vac — to speak (uvāca: perfect 3rd sg. 'said')
glossary.भूय: bhūyaḥ — bhūyas — again, further, once more (bhūyaḥ: adverb; visarga dropped before the vowel e- of eva, -aḥ + e- → -a e-, the rule for any visarga before a non-a vowel)
glossary.महाबाहो: mahā-bāho — mahā — great (first compound member); bāhu — arm (mahā-bāhu: 'great-armed', an epithet of Arjuna, vocative sg.)
glossary.शृणु: śṛṇu — śru — to hear, listen (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg. 'listen!')
glossary.मे: me — aham — I (me: gen. sg. enclitic 'my', governing vacaḥ)
glossary.परमं: paramam — parama — supreme, highest (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with vacaḥ)
glossary.वचः: vacaḥ — vacas — word, speech (acc. sg. neut., object of śṛṇu)
glossary.यत्तेऽहं: yat te aham — yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring back to vacaḥ of pāda a, object of vakṣyāmi; -t + t- → -tt-, assimilation); tvam — you (te: dat. sg. enclitic 'to you', governed with prīyamāṇāya); aham — I (nom. sg., subject of vakṣyāmi; te + aham: -e + a- → -e with avagraha)
glossary.प्रीयमाणाय: prīyamāṇāya — prī — to please, delight (prīyamāṇa: passive present participle 'being pleased, being dear', dat. sg. masc., agreeing with te)
glossary.वक्ष्यामि: vakṣyāmi — vac — to speak, declare (vakṣyāmi: future 1st sg. 'I shall declare')
glossary.हितकाम्यया: hita-kāmyayā — hita — benefit, welfare (first compound member); kāmyā — desire, wish (hita-kāmyā: 'a wish for [your] welfare', instr. sg. fem., adverbial 'out of a desire for your benefit')
glossary.विदुः: viduḥ — vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they know')
glossary.सुरगणाः: sura-gaṇāḥ — sura — god, deity (first compound member); gaṇa — host, multitude (sura-gaṇa: 'the hosts of gods', nom. pl. masc., subject)
glossary.प्रभवं: prabhavam — pra-bhava — origin, source, coming-into-being (acc. sg. masc., object of viduḥ)
glossary.महर्षयः: mahā-ṛṣayaḥ — mahā — great (first compound member); ṛṣi — sage, seer (mahā-ṛṣi: 'great sage', nom. pl. masc., subject, understood with viduḥ prabhavam repeated; ā + ṛ → ar)
glossary.अहमादिर्हि: aham ādiḥ hi — aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before ā-, no change); ādi — beginning, origin (ādiḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate); hi — for, indeed (particle; ādiḥ + hi: -iḥ + h- → -ir h-)
glossary.देवानां: devānām — deva — god, deity (gen. pl., 'of the gods')
glossary.महर्षीणां: mahā-ṛṣīṇām — mahā — great (first compound member); ṛṣi — sage (mahā-ṛṣi: gen. pl., 'of the great sages'; ā + ṛ → ar)
glossary.सर्वशः: sarvaśaḥ — sarvaśas — wholly, in every respect, altogether (adverb)
glossary.यो: yaḥ — yad — who, which (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative pronoun, subject of vetti; -aḥ before m- → -o)
glossary.मामजमनादिं: mām ajam anādim — aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of vetti; joined before a-, no change); a-ja — unborn (ajam: acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām; joined before a-, no change); an-ādi — without beginning, beginningless (anādim: acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām)
glossary.वेत्ति: vetti — vid — to know (vetti: present 3rd sg. 'knows')
glossary.लोकमहेश्वरम्: loka-mahā-īśvaram — loka — world (first compound member); mahā — great (second member); īśvara — lord (loka-mahā-īśvara: 'the great lord of the world', acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām; ā + ī → e)
glossary.असंमूढः: a-saṃmūḍhaḥ — a-sam-muh — to be deluded, confused (saṃmūḍha: past participle negated by a-, 'undeluded', nom. sg. masc., subject)
glossary.स: saḥ — tad — he, that one (nom. sg. masc., resumptive subject; the pronoun sa/eṣa loses its visarga to sa before any following consonant, an exception to the ordinary -aḥ sandhi rules seen elsewhere in this chapter)
glossary.सर्वपापैः: sarva-pāpaiḥ — sarva — all (first compound member); pāpa — sin, evil (sarva-pāpa: 'all sins', instr. pl., 'from all sins')
glossary.प्रमुच्यते: pramucyate — pra-muc — to release, free (pramucyate: passive present 3rd sg. 'is released')
glossary.बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः: buddhiḥ jñānam a-saṃmohaḥ — buddhi — intellect, understanding, the faculty of discernment (nom. sg. fem., subject, understood with the verb bhavanti of verse 5; -iḥ + j- → -ir j-); jñāna — knowledge (nom. sg. neut., subject; joined before a-, no change); a-saṃmoha — freedom from delusion, non-confusion (from sam-muh; nom. sg. masc., subject)
glossary.क्षमा: kṣamā — kṣamā — patience, forbearance (nom. sg. fem., subject)
glossary.सत्यं: satyam — satya — truth, truthfulness (nom. sg. neut., subject)
glossary.दमः: damaḥ — dama — self-restraint, control of the senses (nom. sg. masc., subject)
glossary.शमः: śamaḥ — śama — tranquility, calmness of mind (nom. sg. masc., subject)

glossary.भयं: bhayam — bhaya — fear (nom. sg. neut., subject)

glossary.समता: samatā — sama-tā — sameness, equanimity (nom. sg. fem., subject)
glossary.तुष्टिस्तपो: tuṣṭiḥ tapaḥ — tuṣṭi — contentment, satisfaction (nom. sg. fem., subject; -iḥ + t- → -is t-, visarga before a voiceless consonant); tapas — austerity, ascetic heat (nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ before d- → -o)
glossary.दानं: dānam — dāna — giving, generosity, gift (nom. sg. neut., subject)
glossary.यशोऽयशः: yaśaḥ ayaśaḥ — yaśas — fame, glory (nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha); a-yaśas — ill fame, infamy (nom. sg. neut., subject)
glossary.भवन्ति: bhavanti — bhū — to be, come to be, arise (present 3rd pl. 'they arise'; the predicate completing the list of subjects begun in verse 4)
glossary.भावा: bhāvāḥ — bhāva — state, disposition, quality (nom. pl. masc., subject, summing up the list of verses 4-5a; visarga dropped before the voiced bh- of bhūtānām, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
glossary.मत्त: mattaḥ — mad — me (mattaḥ: ablative sg. 'from me', formed with the ablative suffix -tas; visarga dropped before the vowel e- of eva)
glossary.पृथग्विधाः: pṛthag-vidhāḥ — pṛthak — separately, variously (first compound member; -k + v- → -g v-, voicing); vidha — kind, sort (pṛthag-vidha: 'of various/manifold kinds', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with bhāvāḥ)
glossary.सप्त: sapta — sapta — seven (numeral, nom. pl., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ)
glossary.पूर्वे: pūrve — pūrva — former, prior, ancient (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ, 'of old')
glossary.चत्वारो: catvāraḥ — catur — four (catvāraḥ: numeral, nom. pl. masc., agreeing with manavaḥ; -aḥ before m- → -o)
glossary.मनवस्तथा: manavaḥ tathā — Manu — Manu, the primal ancestor and lawgiver of mankind (Hindu cosmology names several; the 'four' here are the Manus of the current and preceding aeons; manavaḥ: nom. pl., subject); tathā — likewise, so too (manavaḥ + tathā: -aḥ + t- → -as t-)
glossary.मद्भावा: mad-bhāvāḥ — mad — me (stem form, first compound member); bhāva — nature, state of being (mad-bhāva: 'of my nature, sprung from me', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ and manavaḥ; visarga dropped before the voiced m- of mānasāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
glossary.मानसा: mānasāḥ — mānasa — mind-born, mental, of the mind (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with the same subjects; visarga dropped before the voiced j- of jātāḥ)
glossary.जाता: jātāḥ — jan — to be born (jāta: past participle 'born', nom. pl. masc.; visarga dropped before the voiced y- of yeṣām)
glossary.येषां: yeṣām — yad — who, which (yeṣām: gen. pl. relative, 'of whom', referring to the sages and Manus)
glossary.लोक: lokaḥ — loka — the world (nom. sg. masc., in loose apposition with prajāḥ, 'these creatures of the world'; -aḥ + i- → -a i-, visarga simply dropping before a vowel other than a-)
glossary.इमाः: imāḥ — idam — this (imāḥ: nom. pl. fem., agreeing with prajāḥ)
glossary.प्रजाः: prajāḥ — prajā — offspring, creature, progeny (nom. pl. fem., subject/predicate)
glossary.एतां: etām — etad — this (acc. sg. fem., agreeing with vibhūtim)
glossary.विभूतिं: vibhūtim — vi-bhūti — manifestation, extraordinary power, glory (acc. sg. fem., object of vetti)
glossary.योगं: yogam — yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (acc. sg. masc., second object of vetti)
glossary.मम: mama — aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my', modifying vibhūtim and yogam)
glossary.तत्त्वतः: tattvataḥ — tattva — true nature, reality, essence (tattvataḥ: adverb 'truly, in reality', formed with the ablative adverbial suffix -tas)
glossary.सोऽविकम्पेन: saḥ avikampena — tad — he (saḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha); a-vikampa — unwavering, untrembling (avikampena: instr. sg., agreeing with yogena)
glossary.योगेन: yogena — yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (instr. sg., 'with [unwavering] yoga')
glossary.युज्यते: yujyate — yuj — to yoke, join, unite (yujyate: passive present 3rd sg. 'is united')
glossary.नात्र: na atra — na — not (na + atra: a + a → ā); atra — here, in this matter
glossary.संशयः: saṃśayaḥ — saṃśaya — doubt (nom. sg. masc., subject)
glossary.सर्वस्य: sarvasya — sarva — all, everything (gen. sg., 'of everything')
glossary.प्रभवो: prabhavaḥ — pra-bhava — origin, source (nom. sg. masc., predicate; -aḥ before m- → -o)
glossary.मत्तः: mattaḥ — mad — me (mattaḥ: ablative sg. 'from me')
glossary.सर्वं: sarvam — sarva — all, everything (nom. sg. neut., subject)
glossary.प्रवर्तते: pravartate — pra-vṛt — to proceed, come forth, evolve (pravartate: present middle 3rd sg.)
glossary.इति: iti — iti — thus (closing the preceding statement)
glossary.मत्वा: matvā — man — to think, consider (matvā: gerund 'having considered, understanding [this]')
glossary.भजन्ते: bhajante — bhaj — to worship, revere, share in (bhajante: present middle 3rd pl. 'they worship')
glossary.मां: mām — aham — I (acc. sg. 'me', object of bhajante)
glossary.बुधा: budhāḥ — budha — wise, learned (nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced bh- of bhāvasamanvitāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
glossary.भावसमन्विताः: bhāva-samanvitāḥ — bhāva — feeling, disposition, state of mind (first compound member); sam-anvita — endowed with, possessed of, imbued with (bhāva-samanvita: 'endowed with [right] feeling', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with budhāḥ)
glossary.मच्चित्ता: mac-cittāḥ — mad — me (stem form, first compound member; mat + citta: -t + c- → -c c-, assimilation); citta — mind, thought (mac-citta: 'whose thoughts are on me', nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced m- of madgataprāṇāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
glossary.मद्गतप्राणा: mad-gata-prāṇāḥ — mad — me (stem form, first compound member; mat + gata: -t + g- → -d g-, voicing); gata — gone to, directed towards (second member); prāṇa — life-breath, vital energy (mad-gata-prāṇa: 'whose vital energies are absorbed in me', nom. pl. masc., subject, in apposition to maccittāḥ; visarga dropped before the voiced b- of bodhayantaḥ)
glossary.बोधयन्तः: bodhayantaḥ — budh — to awaken, understand (causative bodhayanti, 'to enlighten, instruct'; bodhayant: present participle, nom. pl. masc., 'instructing, enlightening [one another]')
glossary.परस्परम्: parasparam — paras-para — each other, one another (parasparam: acc. sg., used adverbially, 'mutually')
glossary.कथयन्तश्च: kathayantaḥ ca — kath — to tell, relate, speak of (causative kathayati; kathayant: present participle, nom. pl. masc., 'speaking of [me]'; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and
glossary.तुष्यन्ति: tuṣyanti — tuṣ — to be content, satisfied (present 3rd pl.)
glossary.रमन्ति: ramanti — ram — to delight, rejoice, take pleasure (present 3rd pl.)
glossary.तेषां: teṣām — tad — they, those (teṣām: gen. pl., 'of them', referring to the devotees of verse 9)
glossary.सततयुक्तानां: satata-yuktānām — satata — constant, continual (first compound member); yukta — joined, disciplined, engaged (satata-yukta: 'constantly disciplined', gen. pl., agreeing with teṣām)
glossary.भजतां: bhajatām — bhaj — to worship, revere (bhajat: present participle 'worshiping', gen. pl., agreeing with teṣām)
glossary.प्रीतिपूर्वकम्: prīti-pūrvakam — prīti — love, affection (first compound member); pūrvaka — preceded by, accompanied by (prīti-pūrvakam: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'lovingly, with affection')
glossary.ददामि: dadāmi — dā — to give (dadāmi: present 1st sg. 'I give')
glossary.बुद्धियोगं: buddhi-yogam — buddhi — intellect, understanding, the faculty of discernment (first compound member); yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (buddhi-yoga: 'the yoga of understanding', acc. sg. masc., object of dadāmi)
glossary.तं: tam — tad — that (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with buddhiyogam)
glossary.येन: yena — yad — which (yena: instr. sg., 'by which')
glossary.मामुपयान्ति: mām upayānti — aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of upayānti; joined before u-, no change); upa-yā — to approach, come to (upayānti: present 3rd pl. 'they come to, attain')
glossary.ते: te — tad — they (nom. pl., resuming teṣām of pāda a)
glossary.तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं: teṣām eva anukampā-artham aham ajñāna-jam — tad — they (teṣām: gen. sg., 'for them', referring to the devotees of verses 9-10; joined before e-, no change); eva — indeed, alone (eva + anukampā: a + a → ā); anukampā — compassion, sympathy (first compound member); artha — purpose, sake (anukampā-artham: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'for the sake of compassion', 'out of compassion'; joined before a-, no change); aham — I (nom. sg., subject of nāśayāmi; joined before a-, no change); a-jñāna — ignorance, absence of knowledge (first compound member); ja — born, arising from (ajñāna-ja: 'born of ignorance', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with tamaḥ)
glossary.तमः: tamaḥ — tamas — darkness (acc. sg. neut., object of nāśayāmi in the next line)
glossary.नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो: nāśayāmi ātma-bhāva-sthaḥ — naś — to be destroyed, perish (causative nāśayati, 'to destroy'; nāśayāmi: present 1st sg. 'I destroy'; -i + ā- → -y ā-); ātman — self, soul (first compound member); bhāva — being, inner state (second member); stha — situated, abiding (ātma-bhāva-stha: 'abiding in [their] inmost being', nom. sg. masc., agreeing with the subject aham; -aḥ before j- → -o)
glossary.ज्ञानदीपेन: jñāna-dīpena — jñāna — knowledge (first compound member); dīpa — lamp, light (jñāna-dīpa: 'the lamp of knowledge', instr. sg., instrumental means of destroying tamaḥ)
glossary.भास्वता: bhāsvatā — bhāsvat — shining, radiant, brilliant (instr. sg., agreeing with jñānadīpena)
glossary.अर्जुन: arjunaḥ — Arjuna — Arjuna, the third Pāṇḍava, the great archer (nom. sg.)
glossary.उवाच: uvāca — vac — to speak (uvāca: perfect 3rd sg. 'said')
glossary.परं: param — para — higher, supreme (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with brahma)
glossary.ब्रह्म: brahma — brahman — brahman, kept untranslated (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
glossary.धाम: dhāma — dhāman — abode, dwelling-place, radiance (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
glossary.पवित्रं: pavitram — pavitra — pure, purifying (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
glossary.भवान्: bhavān — bhavat — you, your reverence (bhavān: honorific 2nd person pronoun, nom. sg. masc., subject)
glossary.पुरुषं: puruṣam — puruṣa — person, spirit (acc. sg. masc.; this line's epithets continue as object complements of āhuḥ tvām, 'they call you', in the next verse)
glossary.शाश्वतं: śāśvatam — śāśvata — eternal, everlasting, perpetual (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
glossary.दिव्यमादिदेवमजं: divyam ādi-devam ajam — divya — divine, heavenly (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam; joined before ā-, no change); ādi — first, primal (first compound member); deva — god (ādi-deva: 'the primal god', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam; joined before a-, no change); a-ja — unborn (ajam: acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
glossary.विभुम्: vibhum — vibhu — all-pervading, mighty, powerful (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
glossary.आहुस्त्वामृषयः: āhuḥ tvām ṛṣayaḥ — ah — to say, declare, call (āhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they call'; -uḥ + t- → -us t-); tvam — you (tvām: acc. sg., object of āhuḥ, continuing the epithets of verse 12 line b); ṛṣi — sage, seer (ṛṣayaḥ: nom. pl., subject of āhuḥ; joined before ṛ-, no change)
glossary.सर्वे: sarve — sarva — all (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with ṛṣayaḥ)
glossary.देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा: devarṣiḥ Nāradaḥ tathā — deva — god, divine (first compound member); ṛṣi — sage (deva-ṛṣi: 'divine sage', a class of celestial seer, nom. sg. masc.; a + ṛ → ar); Nārada — the sage Nārada, a celestial seer and messenger among the gods, traditionally a son of Brahmā (nom. sg., in apposition to devarṣiḥ; -iḥ + n- → -ir n-); tathā — likewise, also (Nāradaḥ + tathā: -aḥ + t- → -as t-)
glossary.असितो: Asitaḥ — Asita — the sage Asita, a seer associated with Devala (nom. sg.; -aḥ before d- → -o)
glossary.देवलो: Devalaḥ — Devala — the sage Devala, often paired with Asita in tradition (nom. sg.; -aḥ before v- → -o)
glossary.व्यासः: Vyāsaḥ — Vyāsa — the sage Vyāsa, compiler of the Vedas and the Mahābhārata, traditionally the poem's own narrator's source (nom. sg.)
glossary.स्वयं: svayam — svayam — oneself, in person (adverb/pronoun, here agreeing with the understood 'you')
glossary.चैव: ca eva — ca — and (ca + eva: a + e → ai); eva — indeed, also
glossary.ब्रवीषि: bravīṣi — brū — to say, speak, declare (bravīṣi: present 2nd sg. 'you say')
glossary.सर्वमेतदृतं: sarvam etat ṛtam — sarva — all, entirely (sarvam: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'wholly'; joined before e-, no change); etad — this (etat: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with ṛtam; -t + ṛ- → -d ṛ-, voicing before a vowel); ṛta — true, truth (acc. sg. neut., object of manye)
glossary.मन्ये: manye — man — to think, believe, consider (manye: present middle 1st sg. 'I believe')
glossary.यन्मां: yat mām — yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring to etad ṛtam, object of vadasi; -t + m- → -n m-, assimilation); aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of vadasi)
glossary.वदसि: vadasi — vad — to speak, say, tell (vadasi: present 2nd sg. 'you tell')
glossary.केशव: keśava — Keśava — 'having fine hair' or 'slayer of the demon Keśin', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative)
glossary.भगवन्व्यक्तिं: bhagavan vyaktim — bhagavat — the Blessed One, the Lord (bhagavan: vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa; joined before v-, no change); vi-akti — manifestation, self-revelation, true nature (vyaktim: acc. sg. fem., object of viduḥ)
glossary.विदुर्देवा: viduḥ devāḥ — vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they know'; -uḥ + d- → -ur d-); deva — god, deity (devāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced n- of na, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
glossary.दानवाः: dānavāḥ — dānava — demon, titan, son of Danu (nom. pl. masc., subject)
glossary.स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं: svayam eva ātmanā ātmānam — svayam — oneself, of one's own accord (adverb); eva — indeed, emphatic (particle; eva + ātmanā: a + ā → ā); ātman — self (ātmanā: instr. sg., 'by [your] own self'); ātman — self (ātmānam: acc. sg., 'your own self', object of vettha; ātmanā + ātmānam: ā + ā → ā)
glossary.वेत्थ: vettha — vid — to know (vettha: an old perfect form used as present, 2nd sg. 'you know')
glossary.पुरुषोत्तम: puruṣa-uttama — puruṣa — person, spirit (first compound member); uttama — highest, supreme (puruṣa-uttama: 'supreme Person', vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa; a + u → o)
glossary.भूतभावन: bhūta-bhāvana — bhūta — being, creature (first compound member); bhāvana — one who brings into being, originator (from bhū causative; bhūta-bhāvana: 'origin of beings', vocative sg.)
glossary.भूतेश: bhūta-īśa — bhūta — being, creature (first compound member); īśa — lord, ruler (bhūta-īśa: 'lord of beings', vocative sg.; a + ī → e)
glossary.देवदेव: deva-deva — deva — god, deity (first compound member); deva — god, deity (deva-deva: 'god of gods', vocative sg.)
glossary.जगत्पते: jagat-pate — jagat — world, universe (first compound member); pati — lord, master (jagat-pate: 'lord of the world', vocative sg.)
glossary.वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण: vaktum arhasi aśeṣeṇa — vac — to speak (vaktum: infinitive, 'to declare, tell'; joined before a-, no change); arh — to deserve, be worthy, ought (arhasi: present 2nd sg., 'you should, ought to'); a-śeṣa — without remainder, in full (aśeṣeṇa: instr. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'exhaustively, fully'; arhasi + aśeṣeṇa: -i + a- → -ya, the glide-formation rule seen at 10.11 (-i + ā- → -yā) here extended to a following short a)
glossary.दिव्या: divyāḥ — divya — divine, heavenly (nom. pl. fem., agreeing with vibhūtayaḥ; visarga dropped before the voiced h- of hi, the -āḥ pattern seen since 10.2)
glossary.ह्यात्मविभूतयः: hi ātma-vibhūtayaḥ — hi — for, indeed (particle; hi + ātma-: -i + ā- → -y ā-, as at 10.11); ātman — self, one's own (first compound member); vibhūti — manifestation, extraordinary power (ātma-vibhūti: 'self-manifestation', nom. pl. fem., subject; cf. vibhūti at 10.7)
glossary.याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं: yābhiḥ vibhūtibhiḥ lokān imān tvam — yad — which (yābhiḥ: instr. pl. fem., 'by which'); vibhūti — manifestation (vibhūtibhiḥ: instr. pl., 'by [which] manifestations'; yābhiḥ + vibhūtibhiḥ: -iḥ + v- → -ir v-); loka — world (lokān: acc. pl. masc., object of vyāpya; vibhūtibhiḥ + lokān: -iḥ + l- → -ir l-); idam — this (imān: acc. pl. masc., agreeing with lokān; joined before i-, no change); tvam — you (nom. sg., subject of tiṣṭhasi; imān + tvam: -n + t- → -ṃs t-, a new pattern — word-final -n before t-/th- inserts -s-)
glossary.व्याप्य: vyāpya — vi-āp — to pervade, fill (vyāpya: gerund, 'having pervaded')
glossary.तिष्ठसि: tiṣṭhasi — sthā — to stand, abide, remain (tiṣṭhasi: present 2nd sg., 'you stand, abide')
glossary.विद्यामहं: vidyām aham — vid — to know (vidyām: optative 1st sg., 'may I know'; joined before a-, no change); aham — I (nom. sg., subject)
glossary.योगिंस्त्वां: yogin tvām — yogin — one possessed of yoga, a yogin (vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa); tvam — you (tvām: acc. sg., object of paricintayan; yogin + tvām: -n + t- → -ṃs t-, as at 10.16)
glossary.परिचिन्तयन्: paricintayan — pari-cint — to reflect on, meditate upon (paricintayan: present participle, nom. sg. masc., 'meditating')
glossary.केषु: keṣu — kim — what, which (keṣu: loc. pl., 'in which')
glossary.भावेषु: bhāveṣu — bhāva — state of being, condition (loc. pl., 'in [what] states')
glossary.चिन्त्योऽसि: cintyaḥ asi — cint — to think of, meditate on (cintyaḥ: gerundive, 'to be meditated upon', nom. sg. masc.; cintyaḥ + asi: -aḥ + a- → -o-); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg., 'you are')
glossary.भगवन्मया: bhagavan mayā — bhagavat — the Blessed One, the Lord (bhagavan: vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa; joined before m-, no change); aham — I (mayā: instr. sg., 'by me')
glossary.विस्तरेणात्मनो: vistareṇa ātmanaḥ — vistara — extent, detail, length (vistareṇa: instr. sg. used adverbially, 'at length, in full detail'); ātman — self (ātmanaḥ: gen. sg., 'of your own'; vistareṇa + ātmanaḥ: a + ā → ā, its own visarga then becoming -o before the voiced y- of yogam)
glossary.जनार्दन: janārdana — Janārdana — 'rouser' or 'tormentor of men', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)
glossary.भूयः: bhūyaḥ — bhūyas — again, once more (adverb; cf. 10.1)
glossary.कथय: kathaya — kath — to tell, relate (causative; kathaya: imperative 2nd sg., 'speak! declare!')

glossary.शृण्वतो: śṛṇvataḥ — śru — to hear (śṛṇvataḥ: present participle, gen. sg. masc., 'of [me] hearing, listening'; -aḥ before n- → -o)

glossary.नास्त्यन्तो: na asti antaḥ — na — not (na + asti: a + a → ā); as — to be, exist (asti: present 3rd sg.; asti + antaḥ: -i + a- → -y a-, as at 10.16's arhasyaśeṣeṇa); anta — end, limit (antaḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ before v- → -o)
glossary.विस्तरस्य: vistarasya — vistara — extent, detail (gen. sg., 'of [my] extent')

glossary.रविरंशुमान्: raviḥ aṃśumān — ravi — the sun (nom. sg., predicate; raviḥ + aṃśumān: -iḥ + a- → -ir a-); aṃśumat — possessed of rays, radiant (aṃśumān: nom. sg. masc., agreeing with raviḥ, 'the radiant [sun]')

glossary.नक्षत्राणामहं: nakṣatrāṇām aham — nakṣatra — lunar mansion, constellation (nakṣatrāṇām: gen. pl., 'of the constellations'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)

glossary.देवानामस्मि: devānām asmi — deva — god (devānām: gen. pl., 'of gods'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.वासवः: vāsavaḥ — Vāsava — 'lord of the Vasus', a name of Indra, king of the gods (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.इन्द्रियाणां: indriyāṇām — indriya — sense-organ, faculty (gen. pl., 'of the senses')
glossary.मनश्चास्मि: manaḥ ca asmi — manas — mind (manaḥ: nom. sg., predicate; manaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.भूतानामस्मि: bhūtānām asmi — bhūta — being, creature (bhūtānām: gen. pl., 'of beings'); as — to be (asmi: joined before a-, no change)
glossary.चेतना: cetanā — cetanā — consciousness, sentience (nom. sg. fem., predicate)
glossary.रुद्राणां: rudrāṇām — rudra — Rudra, a class of storm-gods presided over by Śiva (gen. pl., 'of the Rudras')
glossary.शंकरश्चास्मि: śaṅkaraḥ ca asmi — Śaṅkara — 'beneficent one', a name of Śiva (nom. sg., predicate; śaṅkaraḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.वित्तेशो: vitteśaḥ — vitta — wealth, property (first compound member); īśa — lord (vitta-īśa: 'lord of wealth', a name of Kubera, nom. sg., predicate; a + ī → e, its own visarga becoming -o before the voiced y- of yakṣarakṣasām)

glossary.पावकश्चास्मि: pāvakaḥ ca asmi — Pāvaka — 'purifier', a name of Agni, the fire-god (nom. sg., predicate; pāvakaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.मेरुः: meruḥ — Meru — the cosmic mountain Meru, at the center of the world (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.शिखरिणामहम्: śikhariṇām aham — śikharin — having a peak, a peaked mountain (gen. pl., 'of peaked mountains'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.पुरोधसां: purodhasām — purodhas — household priest, chaplain (gen. pl., 'of household priests')
glossary.मुख्यं: mukhyam — mukhya — chief, foremost (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with mām, object complement)
glossary.विद्धि: viddhi — vid — to know (viddhi: imperative 2nd sg., 'know!')
glossary.पार्थ: pārtha — Pārtha — 'son of Pṛthā', an epithet of Arjuna (vocative sg.)
glossary.बृहस्पतिम्: bṛhaspatim — Bṛhaspati — the preceptor and chief priest of the gods (acc. sg., in apposition to mām, 'me — Bṛhaspati')
glossary.सेनानीनामहं: senānīnām aham — senānī — army-leader, commander (gen. pl., 'of army-commanders'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)

glossary.सरसामस्मि: sarasām asmi — saras — lake, pool, body of water (sarasām: gen. pl., 'of bodies of water'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.सागरः: sāgaraḥ — sāgara — the ocean (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.भृगुरहं: bhṛguḥ aham — Bhṛgu — the great sage Bhṛgu, one of the mind-born sons of Brahmā (nom. sg., predicate; bhṛguḥ + aham: -uḥ + a- → -ur a-); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; bhṛguḥ + aham: -uḥ + a- → -ur a-)
glossary.गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम्: girām asmi ekam akṣaram — gir — speech, utterance, word (girām: gen. pl., 'of utterances'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; asmi + ekam: -i + e- → -y e-); eka — one, single (first compound member; joined before a-, no change); a-kṣara — imperishable, syllable (eka-akṣara: 'the single syllable', i.e. the sacred Oṃ, acc. sg. neut., predicate)

glossary.हिमालयः: himālayaḥ — Himālaya — 'abode of snow', the Himālaya mountains (nom. sg., predicate)

glossary.देवर्षीणां: deva-ṛṣīṇām — deva — god (first compound member; deva + ṛṣi: a + ṛ → ar, as at 10.13); ṛṣi — sage (deva-ṛṣi: gen. pl., 'of divine sages')

glossary.चित्ररथः: citrarathaḥ — Citraratha — 'having a bright chariot', king of the gandharvas (nom. sg., predicate)

glossary.मुनिः: muniḥ — muni — sage (nom. sg., in apposition to Kapilaḥ)
glossary.उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां: uccaiḥśravasam aśvānām — Uccaiḥśravas — 'long-eared' or 'loud-neighing', the divine horse that arose at the churning of the ocean of milk (uccaiḥśravasam: acc. sg., object of viddhi; joined before a-, no change); aśva — horse (aśvānām: gen. pl., 'of horses')

glossary.ऐरावतं: airāvatam — Airāvata — the divine elephant of Indra, likewise born at the churning of the ocean (acc. sg., in apposition to mām)
glossary.गजेन्द्राणां: gaja-indrāṇām — gaja — elephant (first compound member; gaja + indra: a + i → e); indra — lord, chief (gaja-indra: 'lordly elephant', gen. pl., 'of lordly elephants')
glossary.नराधिपम्: nara-adhipam — nara — man (first compound member; nara+adhipa: a+a→ā); adhipa — lord, ruler (nara-adhipa: 'the lord of men, the king', acc. sg., in apposition to mām)
glossary.आयुधानामहं: āyudhānām aham — āyudha — weapon (āyudhānām: gen. pl., 'of weapons'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.वज्रं: vajram — vajra — the thunderbolt, Indra's weapon (nom. sg. neut., predicate)
glossary.धेनूनामस्मि: dhenūnām asmi — dhenu — cow (dhenūnām: gen. pl., 'of cows'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.कामधुक्: kāmadhuk — kāma-duh — 'yielding [every] desire', the wish-fulfilling cow Kāmadhenu (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.प्रजनश्चास्मि: prajanaḥ ca asmi — pra-jana — begetter, progenitor (prajanaḥ: nom. sg., predicate; prajanaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.कन्दर्पः: kandarpaḥ — Kandarpa — the god of love, Kāma (nom. sg., in apposition to prajanaḥ)
glossary.सर्पाणामस्मि: sarpāṇām asmi — sarpa — serpent (sarpāṇām: gen. pl., 'of serpents'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.वासुकिः: vāsukiḥ — Vāsuki — Vāsuki, king of the serpents (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.अनन्तश्चास्मि: anantaḥ ca asmi — Ananta — Ananta, 'endless', a name of Śeṣa, the cosmic serpent-king on whom Viṣṇu reclines (nom. sg., predicate; anantaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.नागानां: nāgānām — nāga — a serpent-deity, nāga (gen. pl., 'of nāgas')
glossary.वरुणो: varuṇaḥ — Varuṇa — the god Varuṇa, lord of the waters (nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ before y- → -o)
glossary.यादसामहम्: yādasām aham — yādas — a water-dwelling being, water-deity (yādasām: gen. pl., 'of water-deities'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.पितॄणामर्यमा: pitṝṇām aryamā — pitṛ — ancestor, forefather (pitṝṇām: gen. pl., 'of ancestors'); Aryaman — Aryaman, one of the Ādityas, presiding over ancestors and the sacred order (nom. sg., predicate; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.चास्मि: ca asmi — ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.यमः: yamaḥ — Yama — Yama, god of death and lord of the ancestors, restrainer of all beings by law (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.संयमतामहम्: saṃyamatām aham — saṃ-yam — to restrain, control (saṃyamatām: present participle gen. pl., 'of those who restrain, administer law'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.प्रह्लादश्चास्मि: prahlādaḥ ca asmi — Prahlāda — Prahlāda, the devout daitya king, son of Hiraṇyakaśipu, rescued by Viṣṇu's Narasiṃha incarnation (nom. sg., predicate; prahlādaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.दैत्यानां: daityānām — daitya — a daitya, a demon or titan descended from Diti (gen. pl., 'of daityas')
glossary.कालः: kālaḥ — kāla — Time (nom. sg., predicate; capitalized as the house rendering of kāla fixed at 11.32)
glossary.कलयतामहम्: kalayatām aham — kal — to reckon, calculate, compute (kalayatām: present participle gen. pl., 'of those who reckon, calculators'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.मृगाणां: mṛgāṇām — mṛga — wild beast (gen. pl., 'of beasts')
glossary.मृगेन्द्रोऽहं: mṛga-indraḥ aham — mṛga — wild beast (first compound member); indra — lord, chief (mṛga-indra: 'lord of beasts', i.e. the lion, nom. sg., predicate; a + i → e; mṛgendraḥ + aham: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; mṛgendraḥ + aham: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha)
glossary.वैनतेयश्च: vainateyaḥ ca — Vainateya — 'son of Vinatā', an epithet of Garuḍa, king of the birds and Viṣṇu's mount (nom. sg., predicate; vainateyaḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and
glossary.पक्षिणाम्: pakṣiṇām — pakṣin — bird, 'winged one' (gen. pl., 'of birds')
glossary.पवतामस्मि: pavatām asmi — pū — to purify, cleanse (pavatām: present participle gen. pl., 'of purifiers, purifying things'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.रामः: rāmaḥ — Rāma — Rāma, wielder of weapons: read by commentators either as Paraśurāma, the axe-wielding brāhmaṇa avatāra, or as Rāmacandra, hero of the Rāmāyaṇa; the text does not itself decide between them (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.शस्त्रभृतामहम्: śastra-bhṛtām aham — śastra — weapon (first compound member); bhṛt — bearing, wielding (śastra-bhṛt: 'weapon-bearer', bhṛtām: gen. pl., 'of those who bear weapons'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.झषाणां: jhaṣāṇām — jhaṣa — fish, sea-creature (gen. pl., 'of fish')
glossary.मकरश्चास्मि: makaraḥ ca asmi — makara — the crocodile, a mythical river-monster (nom. sg., predicate; makaraḥ + ca: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (ca + asmi: a + a → ā); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)
glossary.स्रोतसामस्मि: srotasām asmi — srotas — stream, river (gen. pl., 'of rivers'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.; joined before a-, no change)

glossary.अध्यात्मविद्या: adhyātma-vidyā — adhi-ātman — adhyātma, 'pertaining to the self' (glossed here as svabhāva, one's own essential nature); the fixed English rendering, set at 8.3's review, is 'the individual self' (first compound member; i + ā → y ā, the same glide-formation as -i + ā- at 10.11, 10.16, here compound-internally); vidyā — science, branch of knowledge (adhyātma-vidyā: 'the science of the individual self', nom. sg. fem., predicate)

glossary.वादः: vādaḥ — vāda — argument, reasoned debate, discourse (nom. sg. masc., predicate)
glossary.प्रवदतामहम्: pravadatām aham — pra-vad — to speak forth, argue, debate (pravadatām: present participle gen. pl., 'of debaters, disputants'); aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before a-, no change)
glossary.अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि: akṣarāṇām akāraḥ asmi — akṣara — letter, imperishable syllable (gen. pl., 'of letters'); a-kāra — the letter, the sound A (nom. sg., predicate; akṣarāṇām + akāraḥ: joined, no change; akāraḥ + asmi: -aḥ + a- → -o-, avagraha); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg.)

glossary.सामासिकस्य: sāmāsikasya — sāmāsika — belonging to a compound, compound-word (adj. used substantively, gen. sg. as a class-genitive, 'of compound words')

about: Chapter 10, Vibhūtiyoga, "the yoga of the divine manifestations," has Kṛṣṇa resume his teaching once more for Arjuna's benefit, opening by restating his own unoriginated nature — without beginning among gods or great sages, the one source from whom they all spring — and by cataloging the many states of mind (intellect, knowledge, patience, truth, fear, fearlessness, non-violence, and more) that arise from him alone, before naming the seven great sages and the four Manus, ancestors of all beings, as likewise born of his mind and his power. Whoever truly knows this unoriginated greatness, Kṛṣṇa says, is freed from delusion and worshipped by the wise with a devotion that grants understanding itself. Arjuna responds with an extended eulogy, affirming Kṛṣṇa as the supreme brahman, the supreme abode, the eternal divine Person, praised as such by the sages and by Kṛṣṇa's own testimony, and then presses him, since only Kṛṣṇa can truly know himself, to declare without remainder the full extent of his own divine manifestations and his yoga, insisting he can never tire of hearing it. Kṛṣṇa agrees, conceding only that the chief manifestations can be told since his extent has no end, and unfolds the poem's great catalog (vv.19-39): he is the Self seated in the heart of all beings, the beginning, middle and end of all; and then, class by class, he identifies himself as the foremost of each — Viṣṇu among the Ādityas, the sun among lights, Indra among gods, Śiva among the Rudras, Meru among mountains, the ocean among bodies of water, Bhṛgu among sages, the sacred syllable Oṃ among utterances, the Himālaya, the sacred fig tree, Nārada, Uccaiḥśravas and Airāvata born of the churning of the ocean, the wish-fulfilling cow, the serpent Ananta, Varuṇa, Yama, Prahlāda, Time itself, the lion, Garuḍa, the wind, Rāma, the crocodile, the Gaṅgā, the science of the individual self, debate, the syllable A, the copulative compound, the great feminine qualities of fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness and patience, sacred chants and metres and months and seasons, gambling, splendor, victory, resolve, virtue, his own clan-name Vāsudeva, Arjuna himself among the Pāṇḍavas, Vyāsa among sages, Uśanas among poets, the rod of the punisher, the policy of the ambitious, the silence of secrets, and the knowledge of the knowing, before declaring that he is simply the seed of all beings, and that nothing whatsoever, moving or unmoving, could exist without him. The chapter closes (vv.40-42) by insisting the catalog is inexhaustible, offered only as a sample of his extent, and that whatever being anywhere possesses glory, splendor or vigor has sprung from a mere fraction of Kṛṣṇa's own splendor — so that, he tells Arjuna, all this detailed enumeration hardly matters next to the one plain fact: he stands sustaining the entire universe with but a single fraction of himself.
